brief: The canvas presents a complex, three-dimensional structure of semi-transparent, glowing geometric planes intersected by luminous connecting lines. The entire configuration rotates slowly, creating a shifting, intricate field of light. The focus is on the connection lines, which serve as visual indicators of proximity. Whenever two of the planes drift into close range, the connecting lines pulse in intense brilliance and glow visibly, accentuating the precise moments of intersection and near-contact. Complementing the geometry, two distinct blocks of typography slowly float across the scene, branding the visualization.

lineage.critique: depart: the concept of connecting luminous surfaces taken into a tapestry of repeating, interlocking wave motifs and stylized natural forms, rendered on paper like a dynamic woodblock print, seen at full scale, in the Edo era.

statement: This visualization presents a dynamic, three-dimensional field of intersecting geometric planes rendered in the WEBGL context. The planes pulse with glowing wave-like patterns that shift continuously across their surfaces, creating an organic flow within a structured framework. Connecting lines between planes intensify and brighten when planes approach each other, indicating moments of proximity and near-intersection. Two floating typography blocks drift slowly through the scene, serving as visual anchors amidst the abstract geometry. The entire composition rotates slowly, revealing the intricate interplay between form and space, with the pulse effects accentuating the relationships between elements in real-time.
